name: haravan
description: Turn Haravan shop data into sales and profit reports, channel and product breakdowns, order lists, and low-stock and inventory summaries, and confirm, close, tag, assign or add notes to orders after you approve each change.

interface.shortDescription: Sales and stock insights from Haravan
interface.longDescription: Haravan for ChatGPT helps authorized merchants understand sales and stock and manage orders in their connected shop. Ask for net sales, profit or quantity sold over a period, compare this week with the previous week, see a day-by-day trend, break sales down by channel, product, branch or province, find orders created yesterday that are still unfulfilled, see which products are about to run out, check stock on hand by branch, or review stock transfers between branches. Sales and stock figures come from Haravan Reports; order lists come from the shop's orders. Reports state the requested date range and the metrics used, and are limited by the shop's permissions and available data. It can also confirm, close or re-open orders, add or remove order tags, assign the staff member who handles orders, or add to an order's note: every change is first shown on a confirmation card and runs only after the merchant presses Confirm. It does not create or cancel orders, issue refunds, edit products or adjust stock.
capabilities: Read connected order, sales, inventory, stock transfer, branch and staff data
Summarize sales performance, fulfillment and stock levels
Confirm, close, re-open, tag, assign and annotate orders after the merchant confirms
defaultPrompt: Compare this week with last week: net sales, profit, and quantity sold.
For yesterday, list every order still unfulfilled and give me the count.
Which products will run out of stock soonest, and at which branch?

review.commerce_description: This plugin is for merchants managing their own Haravan shops. It reads order, sales report, inventory, branch and staff data. Its only write actions are confirming, closing and re-opening orders, adding or removing order tags, assigning the staff member who handles orders and appending to an order's note; each one is shown on a confirmation card and applied only after the merchant presses Confirm on that card. It does not create or cancel orders, issue refunds, edit products, customers or discounts, or adjust stock.

positive.description: Create a weekly sales overview and compare it with the previous week.
positive.prompt: Prepare a sales report for the past week: net sales, profit and quantity sold, and how it compares with the previous week.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the past-week and previous-week date ranges and calls analyze_sales once per week with metrics such as NetSaleAmount, Profit and Quantity and no dimensions. It reports both date ranges, the time zone and the metric names used, and notes that cancelled orders are excluded.

positive.description: List orders created yesterday that remain unfulfilled.
positive.prompt: For yesterday, list every order that is still unfulfilled, show its order number and fulfillment status, and give me the count.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls search_orders with yesterday's creation range and fulfillment_status unshipped, requests further pages while has_more is true, and reports order numbers, fulfillment statuses and the count. It states the date range and time zone, and does not retrieve unrelated customer details or modify orders.

positive.description: Show a day-by-day sales trend for a requested week.
positive.prompt: Show me a day-by-day sales trend for the past week with net sales and quantity sold.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls analyze_sales for the week with dimensions Day and metrics NetSaleAmount and Quantity, sorted by day, and presents one row per day in Vietnam time, treating days without rows as zero. It states the date range and metrics used.

positive.prompt: For the past week, compare net sales and quantity sold by sales channel.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls analyze_sales with dimensions SourceName and reports only the channels returned, with the date range and metrics used. It requests further pages while has_more is true.

positive.description: Find products that are about to run out of stock.
positive.prompt: Which products will run out of stock soonest, and at which branch? Show the days of stock left.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls list_low_stock with the default soonest-stockout ordering and reports each variant and branch with quantity on hand, average quantity sold per day and estimated days until stockout. It does not change stock or create purchase orders.

positive.description: Summarize stock on hand by branch.
positive.prompt: How much stock do I have at each branch, and what is it worth at cost?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_inventory_balances with dimensions LocId and metrics QtyOnHand, QtyAvailable and TotalCostAmount, and reports one row per branch, requesting further pages while has_more is true.

positive.description: List stock transfers received at a named branch.
positive.prompt: Show the stock transfers sent to my Hà Nội branch, with status and quantity.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls list_locations to find the id of the Hà Nội branch, then calls list_inventory_transfers with to_location_id set to that id, requesting further pages while has_more is true. It reports each transfer's number, source branch name, status, reason and quantity, and does not change stock.

positive.description: Tag a set of orders after the merchant confirms on the card.
positive.prompt: Add the tag “urgent” to every order created yesterday that is still unfulfilled.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls search_orders for yesterday's unfulfilled orders, then calls preview_add_order_tags once with all their ids and tags "urgent". A confirmation card lists the orders and the tag. The assistant says nothing has changed until the merchant presses Confirm; only the card calls add_order_tags, and the assistant then reports the result per order.

positive.description: Add a note to an order after the merchant confirms on the card.
positive.prompt: Add the note “Customer asked for delivery after 5pm” to my most recent order.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the latest order with search_orders and calls preview_add_order_note with its id and the note text. The card shows the current note and the text to add. The assistant does not claim the note was added until the card reports Confirm, and the existing note is kept.

negative.description: Cancelling orders is outside the plugin's scope; the assistant should explain this without calling a write tool.
negative.prompt: Cancel my last order because the customer changed their mind.

negative.description: Refunds are outside the plugin's scope; the assistant should explain this without invoking tools.
negative.prompt: Refund 200,000đ to the customer of my last order.

negative.description: The plugin cannot change product prices or stock.
negative.prompt: Change the price of my best-selling product to 150,000đ and set its stock to 100.

negative.description: Creating discount codes is outside the plugin's read-only scope. The assistant should explain this limitation without invoking tools.
negative.prompt: Create a 10% discount code for my store.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.4: the plugin can now confirm, close and re-open orders, add or remove order tags, assign the staff member who handles orders and add to an order's note, for up to 20 orders at a time. Each change is shown on a confirmation card and applied only after the merchant presses Confirm. New list_inventory_transfers, list_locations and list_staff tools show stock transfers between branches, the shop's branches and its staff. The app now also requests the order write, inventory read and shop read permissions, so existing shops must reconnect.
